title: Chromatic polynomial of the cycle graph
statement:
Let $n \ge 3$, let $C_n$ denote the cycle graph on $n$ vertices, and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer. Then the number of distinct proper $k$-colourings of $C_n$ is
\[
\pi_k(C_n) = (k-1)^n + (-1)^n\,(k-1).
\]
hypotheses_covered: cycle has length n with n ≥ 3
k is a natural number (number of available colours)
the graph is the cycle graph on n vertices
replaced:
